amendment_basis.stage: after source-only image integrity census; before any source training, development/calibration/test acquisition or target outcome access by this work
amendment_basis.rationale: Retain the exact official source multiset and its conflicting annotations. Cross-entropy does not require deterministic labels given an image. Keep identical decoded images in one source-fit/monitor group to avoid exact-duplicate leakage. Annotation correctness, semantic ambiguity, near-duplicate independence and target exchangeability are not established.

v1_disposition: strict rejection remains available and its failed validation is preserved; V2 is explicit and never an automatic fallback
